title: Dollys Dream House Champagne Bar w DT views
description:
Experience the ultimate Nashville getaway at this Dolly Parton themed home. Featuring a stunning rooftop Champagne Bar with skyline views and vibrant custom murals, this 4 bedroom retreat is perfect for groups. Enjoy modern amenities including a fully equipped kitchen, high speed WiFi, and free parking. Located just 10 minutes from the excitement of Broadway, this stylish house offers the perfect blend of comfort and Music City charm for your next vacation.

The space
Layout:

"The Dolly Suite " - 1 Queen bed (memory foam mattress)
"The Johnny" -  3 Queen beds (memory foam mattresses) + Makeup Vanity
"The Library" -  2 Twin beds (memory foam mattresses)
 "The Rainbow Room" -  Media room w/ 1 Full pullout bed

Perks:

▶︎ Third floor "Champagne Bar" with downtown skyline views
▶︎ Common area with multiple murals and photo opps!
▶︎ Free parking
▶︎ Hi-speed Internet
▶︎ Washer + Dryer available for use
▶︎ Soft, clean linens for each bed
▶︎ Fresh towels, shampoo, body wash and hair dryer provided
▶︎ 5 minute uber to Broadway hotspots

STR Permit # is listed in photo caption

Guest access
You will have full and private access to the entire house during your stay. This includes all four bedrooms, three and a half bathrooms, the fully equipped kitchen, and the spacious living area. Guests are also welcome to enjoy the private patio and the rooftop area known as The Champagne Bar, which offers a great space to relax. For your convenience, you will have a private entrance and access to a dedicated parking spot in the driveway, in addition to free street parking available nearby.

Other things to note
Literally minutes to all the best of Nashville! Recommendations for restaurants and music venues available upon request.

If you love this listing but your dates are unavailable, check the sister properties next door - airbnb.com/h/thejolene or airbnb.com/h/thelegends

For groups over 12 (and up to 24), you can book our combo listing - airbnb.com/h/dollyhouse

Please note, this house is attached to its sister property, "The Jolene," and shares the common area with one additional property.  Guests are kindly asked to be respectful to other guests and adhere to the quiet hours.

While we do love pets, unfortunately we cannot allow them in the home. Smoking and parties are also prohibited.
